summary: Coherus Oncology, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new senior secured term loan facility. On August 12, 2026, the company, with subsidiaries, entered a Loan and Security Agreement with Innovatus Life Sciences Lending Fund I, LP, as collateral agent, providing a $55 million Tranche A Term Loan maturing August 2031. The company drew the full amount on August 14, 2026, using proceeds to repay prior senior debt. The loan bears floating interest at 4.15% plus the greater of Prime Rate or 6.75%, with interest-only payments for 36-48 months. Additional tranches of $25 million and $20 million are available under conditions. This is a debt refinancing, not a special situation.
